subject: Location assurance playbook & activation conditions — EU/US/APAC deployment commitments

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Clarification: activation conditions for EU-hosted variants

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the initial RFP package. A couple of clarifications from our side before we proceed to legal:

- Can you confirm which triggers cause a region fallback (e.g., capacity exhaustion vs. zonal outage vs. planned maintenance)?
- For EU-bound traffic, what are the activation windows and lead times for enabling an EU-only tenant vs. rolling fallback to US temporarily?
- Is there a documented SLA/credit implication if fallback across regions occurs for more than 15 minutes?

We need these specifics to include in our procurement scoring matrix and to decide whether to require a cross-border exception clause in the contract.

Could you provide a short playbook or matrix that maps incident type -> remediation action -> expected activation time? If possible, include how caching/prefix rules affect stateful session continuity.

Best,
Emma Lowe
Head of Procurement
NovaHealth

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@novahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: activation conditions for EU-hosted variants

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below, and I attached a compact playbook and activation matrix for review.

- Triggers for cross-region fallback: prioritized as (1) capacity exhaustion at pinned model variant (autoscale exhausted), (2) AZ/zonal outage impacting GPU pool health, (3) regional control-plane degradation impacting rollout coordination, (4) planned maintenance only when scheduled windows are accepted by customer.
- Activation windows / lead times: in normal autoscale scenarios we can surface a capacity-based fallback within ~120–180s; for AZ outages it’s typically in the 3–7 minute range depending on session state and KV cache priming. For a full region failover (rare) expect 10–30 minutes to reach steady-state routing and cache warm-up.
- SLA/credits: if a fallback to a non-EU region is initiated automatically by the platform without prior agreed exception, it will be treated as a service incident and handled under the Dedicated/Private SLA. We include credits for sustained cross-region traffic > 15 minutes as a partial service failure event — details in the attached playbook.

Note on stateful sessions and caching: prefix/KV cache is not synchronously copied across regions. We keep ephemeral cache for 30 minutes by default; session continuity will be best-effort during cross-region fallback and we recommend stateless prompt designs or user-visible retry guidelines for strict continuity.

Attachments: location-assurance-playbook.pdf, activation-conditions-matrix.xlsx (both attached). I also linked a short HubSpot note and a Drive copy.

Next steps: if you want, I can schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough with our ops leads (Jonas) and Legal (Laura) to confirm contractual language.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Clarification: activation conditions for EU-hosted variants

Emma/Aditya — looping in a couple of legal/contract clarifications we typically require for cross-border exceptions: 

1) Contract clause request: we can provide a narrowly-scoped cross-border fallback clause that requires Redwood to: (a) notify within 5 minutes of activation, (b) provide reason code (capacity/incident/maintenance), (c) commit to remediation ETA and escalation path.
2) Evidence package: following any sustained fallback event (>15 minutes) we will supply an incident packet (timeline, logs, capacity metrics, and RK/KV cache evidence) within 72 hours for audit.
3) Data handling assurance: customer data will not be used to train models and telemetry remains subject to agreed retention. If NovaHealth requires strict EU-only residency, we can offer a Dedicated EU-only tenancy with contractual egress restrictions and on-call runbook testing.

We should confirm whether NovaHealth intends to accept the conditional fallback language or needs a full EU-only commitment (which will be priced differently). Happy to discuss language during the walkthrough.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
